The '''peaceful illusions ''ter'angreal''''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the possession of the [[White Tower]].

==Appearance==
The appearance of this ''ter'angreal'' is unknown.

==Use==
The ''ter'angreal'' creates images of flowers and the sound of a waterfall. Any other use or the original purpose of the item is unknown.

==History==
A member of the [[Kin]] named [[Callie]] who had been put out of the White Tower tried to steal it when she left, but was caught.
